description: Returns the public record for one sequence: identity metadata, release state, availability, COA availability, and evidence links. A record that is not released states no price. Lot-specific certificate data is not exposed here; verify a specific lot through the signed COA flow.

response_format.description: Return shape: json (structured) or markdown (a readable briefing).

slug.description: The sequence slug (storefront URL path segment).

name: defiance_sequence_lookup
title: Look up one chemical sequence by slug
